sections.overview: This Guianan cichlid occurs in the Marowijne basin, between Suriname and French Guiana.
sections.identification: Its dark cheek stripe usually stops before the preopercle, unlike the complete stripe of G. taeniopareius and G. grammepareius.
sections.habitat: It is often found in shallow, sunny channels with moderate or strong flow below cascades.
sections.diet: FishBase gives no prey details for the species.
sections.behavior: Its social behaviour is not described in the species summary.
sections.reproduction: FishBase reports no confirmed breeding account.
sections.ecology: FishBase records G. surinamensis in quieter cascade zones, sometimes with G. harreri.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports global Least Concern, assessed on 27 December 2020.
